entries.title: Psalms 5:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician. Upon Nehiloth. A Psalm of David.>> Give ear to my words, O Jehovah; consider my meditation.

entries.title: Psalms 5:2
segments: Hearken unto the voice of my crying, my king and my God; for to thee will I pray.

entries.title: Psalms 5:3
segments: Jehovah, in the morning shalt thou hear my voice; in the morning will I address myself to thee, and will look up.

entries.title: Psalms 5:4
segments: For thou art not a *God that hath pleasure in wickedness; evil shall not sojourn with thee.

entries.title: Psalms 5:5
segments: Insolent fools shall not stand before thine eyes; thou hatest all workers of iniquity.

entries.title: Psalms 5:6
segments: Thou wilt destroy them that speak lies: Jehovah abhorreth a man of blood and deceit.

entries.title: Psalms 5:7
segments: ¶But as for me, in the greatness of thy loving-kindness will I enter thy house; I will bow down toward the temple of thy holiness in thy fear.

entries.title: Psalms 5:8
segments: Lead me, Jehovah, in thy righteousness, because of my foes; make thy way plain before me.

entries.title: Psalms 5:9
segments: For there is no certainty in their mouth; their inward part is perversion, their throat is an open sepulchre; they flatter with their tongue.

entries.title: Psalms 5:10
segments: Bring guilt upon them, O God; let them fall by their own counsels: drive them out in the multitude of their transgressions, for they have rebelled against thee.

entries.title: Psalms 5:11
segments: And all that trust in thee shall rejoice: for ever shall they shout joyously, and thou wilt protect them; and they that love thy name shall exult in thee.

entries.title: Psalms 5:12
segments: For thou, Jehovah, wilt bless the righteous [man]; with favour wilt thou surround him as [with] a shield.
